channel.description: Latest articles from Small Town Woman (smalltownwoman.com)

item.title: Peanut Butter Blossom Cookies
item.description: These classic Peanut Butter Blossom Cookies are one of my most popular Christmas cookies ever. These delectable cuties are packed full of peanut butter flavor and topped with a dark chocolate kiss.

item.title: Homemade Eggnog
item.description: this luscious Homemade Eggnog Recipe comes together quickly in just a few easy steps and tastes much better than store-bought.

item.title: Crockpot Chicken Noodle Soup
item.description: This recipe combines onion, celery, and carrots with tender egg noodles, succulent chicken, and a perfect blend of spices into a delicious, easy crockpot chicken noodle soup.

item.title: Best Banana Cake
item.description: This homemade banana cake is moist and delicious, made with ripe bananas and buttermilk, and topped with an easy five-ingredient cream cheese frosting.

item.title: Peppermint Bark
item.description: With just four ingredients and fifteen minutes hands on time you can make this delicious beautiful Peppermint Bark for the holidays. I mean honestly who doesn't love homemade treats for the holidays.

item.title: Penne alla Vodka
item.description: Penne alla Vodka is penne pasta in a rich creamy slightly tangy tomato sauce with garlic, onions, crushed tomatoes and of course vodka.

item.title: Italian Sausage Soup
item.description: A flavor packed Italian Sausage Soup with fresh onions, carrots, celery and zucchini in a chicken broth base with tomatoes, cannellini beans, and pasta.

item.title: Creamed Spinach
item.description: This easy creamed spinach recipe is sure to impress! With simple ingredients and quick prep time, it's the perfect addition to any meal."

item.title: Carne Guisada
item.description: This easy and delicious Carne Guisada is a flavorful Latin beef stew made with chunks of beef, onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, and warm and smoky spices.

item.title: Tuscan Bean Soup
item.description: Tuscan White Bean Soup is a delectable medley of white beans, bacon, tomatoes, onions, celery, carrots and spinach in a perfectly seasoned broth.
